config.name: idm_head_v1
config.role: multi-domain inverse-dynamics LABELER: frozen flagship-v1 latents -> per-window ego-motion (speed, yaw_rate, steer, long_accel) + 2 s ego-frame trajectory. NON-CAUSAL (sees past AND future frames) — offline labeling only.

encoder.note: encoder is purely visual: encode = readout(encoder(x/255)); no action/speed channel enters the latent.

train.corpora: PhysicalAI parity rig-A + rig-B + comma2k19 (the multi-domain mix)

target_normalisation.note: used INSIDE the loss only; the head's outputs are already in RAW PHYSICAL UNITS (m/s, rad/s, rad, m/s^2, metres).

usage_caveats: speed + longitudinal trajectory are the trustworthy channels (MEASURED cross-domain speed R2 0.60-0.66).
yaw_rate is CAVEATED cross-domain; steer and long_accel are DROPPED as unusable (pilot NOTE 2026-07-24).
NON-CAUSAL by design — never use online/closed-loop.

2026-07-27 (C29): the 'yaw_rate is CAVEATED cross-domain' caveat above was measured against a BROKEN comma2k19 heading label and OVERSTATES the defect. See label_protocol_reissue_2026_07_27 below. steer was separately shown NOT to be unusable (R2 0.742, C4).

provenance.reason: first PERSISTED IDM head. Prior runs (pilot pseudo-label, parity validation, downstream ablation, scale-up) trained an identical head in-process and discarded it.
provenance.evidence_class: MEASURED (this run; val metrics below are held-out)

label_protocol_reissue_2026_07_27.retraction_class: C29 — THE MODEL WAS RIGHT AND THE LABEL WAS WRONG
label_protocol_reissue_2026_07_27.why: comma2k19 heading is arctan2(enu_v_north, enu_v_east) and is UNDEFINED at standstill. MEASURED (…/2026-07-27-idm-v3/results/labels_v3.json): 26.27 % of comma frames below 0.5 m/s carry a physically impossible |yaw_rate| (up to 15.53 rad/s); 0.000 % above 0.5 m/s. PhysicalAI: ZERO in every bin (its heading comes from an orientation quaternion).
label_protocol_reissue_2026_07_27.v_min_used_for_every_number_in_this_card: none — no speed gate was applied
label_protocol_reissue_2026_07_27.NOTHING_IN_THIS_CARD_HAS_BEEN_ALTERED: every val number above is the original measurement and is kept for audit.
